# Release checklist for iad
#
# Replace 4.0.0 below with the version being released.

# set the version and date
    edit Makefile          # VERSION = 4-0-0 and VERSION_DATE
    edit CITATION.cff      # version and date-released
    edit docs/manual.tex   # "This document describes version ..."
#   src/version.c is generated by src/Makefile; nothing to edit
#   \adversion and \iadversion are rewritten by 'make docs'

# update CHANGELOG.rst as needed  `git log v3.16.3..HEAD --pretty=format:"%s"`
    git commit -m 'update recent changes' CHANGELOG.rst
    git push

# regenerate .c and .h from the .w files before committing them
    make tidy
    git commit -a -m 'regenerate sources'

# final sanity check
    make realclean
    make
    make test            # visually check for failures
    make longtest        # visually check for failures
    make wintest         # visually check for failures

# verify first page of source listing is still correct
    open docs/ad_src.pdf
    open docs/iad_src.pdf

# make the unix and windows distributions
    make realclean
    make dists
    git commit -a -m ' version'

# verify the distribution builds and tests on its own
    cd /tmp && unzip -q <repo>/archives/iad-4-0-0.zip
    cd iad-4-0-0 && make && make test

# create tag for release on github
    git tag v4.0.0
    git push origin v4.0.0

# create a release on github and upload latest to omlc.org
#
# do not forget to attach archives/iad-win-4-0-0.zip to release!
    open https://github.com/scottprahl/iad/releases/
    open .
    sftp -b sftp_commands.txt
